name: Agent Orchestrator
description: Runs and supervises parallel coding agents, each in its own branch and worktree, with a planning orchestrator and a live Kanban that tracks PRs, CI and reviews through merge.

skills.name: Isolated Workers
skills.description: Gives each task one coding agent with its own branch and worktree, plus its terminal, isolated browser and pull request in one place.

skills.name: Project Orchestrator
skills.description: Keeps a persistent planning agent per project that turns outcomes into plans, spawns or redirects workers, and coordinates follow-up work.

skills.name: Live Kanban
skills.description: Places every worker on a board derived from session, pull request, CI and review state: Working, Needs you, In review and Ready to merge.

skills.name: ao CLI
skills.description: Drives the local daemon from a shell with ao spawn, ao session, ao project and ao status, each mapped to a documented daemon route.
